cases.sentence: Когда вся работа, которую Соломон делал для дома Господа, была завершена, Соломон принес те вещи, которые посвятил его отец Давид — серебро, золото и всю утварь, — и положил их в сокровищницы ___.
cases.explain: «Божьего дома» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Thus all the work that Solomon did for Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

cases.sentence: Соломон созвал в Иерусалим старейшин Израиля, всех глав ___ и кланов, чтобы перенести ковчег Господнего завета из Сиона, Города Давида .
cases.explain: «израильских родов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

cases.sentence: Соломон созвал в Иерусалим старейшин Израиля, всех глав израильских родов и кланов, чтобы перенести ковчег ___ из Сиона, Города Давида .
cases.explain: «Господнего завета» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

cases.sentence: И все израильтяне собрались у царя во время праздника в ___.
cases.explain: «седьмом месяце» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

cases.sentence: Эти шесты были такие длинные, что их концы было видно со святилища, находящегося перед ___, но снаружи дома их не было видно.
cases.explain: «внутренним святилищем» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary; but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

cases.explain: «сегодняшний день» — after the preposition «по», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary; but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

cases.sentence: В ковчеге же ничего не было, кроме двух ___, которые Моисей положил в него у Хорива, где Господь заключил с израильтянами завет после того, как они вышли из Египта.
cases.explain: «каменных плиток» — after the preposition «кроме», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

cases.sentence: Все левиты, которые были музыкантами — Асаф, Еман, Идутун со своими сыновьями и сородичами, стояли с ___ жертвенника, одетые в тонкий лен, и играли на тарелках, лирах и арфах.
cases.explain: «восточной стороны» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

cases.sentence: Все левиты, которые были музыкантами — Асаф, Еман, Идутун со своими сыновьями и сородичами, стояли с восточной стороны жертвенника, одетые в ___, и играли на тарелках, лирах и арфах.
cases.explain: «тонкий лен» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

cases.sentence: Под звуки труб, тарелок и ___ они возвышали голоса в похвале Господу:
cases.explain: «других инструментов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised Yahweh, saying, “For he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even Yahweh’s house,
